examples.subject: Urgent: Inheritance fund needs your cooperation
examples.body:
Dear 8f5d1a7c9b2d4e179a0f,

I am Mr. Samuel Thompson, a senior official at Global Bank. We recently discovered an unclaimed inheritance fund of $8.6 million belonging to a deceased client. Since no heirs have come forward, we need your help to claim this fund.

20% of the total amount will be yours as compensation. Please respond urgently to samuel.thompson 77 @ gbmail . com.

This transaction is confidential and risk free.

Best regards,
Samuel Thompson
Fax: +44 207 555 1234

examples.subject: Inheritance claim notification - immediate attention required
examples.body:

examples.subject: Next of kin notification for unclaimed inheritance
examples.body:
Dear beneficiary,

I am Mr. Samuel O'Connell, senior legal officer at Royal Trust Bank.
Our records indicate an unclaimed inheritance of USD 8,750,000 from the late Johnathan Miller, who passed away without a legal heir.
You can claim your part of the funds by contacting me at sam.oconnell 19 @ royaltrust . net with your full details.

Please note this is confidential and requires prompt response.

Regards,
Samuel O'Connell
Fax: +44 208 555 9821

http://royaltrust-secure.com/claim
